50+ Shopify brands · 73% of calls resolved autonomously [...] ## What is AI order support and why Shopify stores need it

Order-related questions dominate e-commerce support. WISMO (Where Is My Order?) queries alone can account for 30-40% of all customer tickets.

Add returns, exchanges, and address change requests, and you are looking at the majority of your support workload being repetitive.

Traditional chatbots fall short here because they can match keywords but cannot access live order data.

When a customer asks "Where is my package?", a basic chatbot says "Please contact our support team." That is not helpful.

AI agents work differently. They connect directly to your Shopify store, pull real-time order status, and can take action.

Processing a return? The AI handles it. Customer wants to cancel an unfulfilled order? Done.
